summary: Abundia Global Impact Group filed an 8-K disclosing a securities purchase agreement with Bower Family Holdings, issuing a secured promissory note initially $6.5M, expandable to $10M over two years at 10% interest, secured by property. Proceeds fund working capital and repay $4.19M of existing debt. This is a routine financing event, not a special situation. No acquisition, tender, restructuring, or strategic transaction. The filing is a standard debt obligation announcement under Items 1.01, 2.03, 8.01. What to watch: covenant compliance and any future draws under the note.
